{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# The question asks for conversion rate difference: email minus paid_search
# But channel is not randomly assigned — email was targeted at loyal customers, who have higher baseline conversion
# So we must check if the groups are comparable by customer_segment

# Check if customer_segment is confounding the comparison
print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute the raw difference
raw_diff = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print(f"\nRaw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.4f}")"}
